title: WhatsApp Cloud API send fails with #200 on a number connected through another provider
symptoms: (#200) You do not have the necessary permissions to send messages on behalf of this WhatsApp Business Account
Template approved, token valid, request well formed
cause: When the number's WhatsApp is connected through another business solution provider, a separate Cloud API app cannot send as that number. Subscribing your app to the WABA does not change it.
fix: Send through the provider the number is connected to, or move the number to your own app. One number cannot serve both.
apply: POST /{WABA_ID}/subscribed_apps succeeds but does not lift the #200; check which app or provider owns the number in WhatsApp Manager.
